cands.bio: Democratic candidate for Alabama House District 63. She ran in the January 2026 special election and the November 2026 general election, losing both to Republican incumbent Norman Crow. No occupation or offices held are documented in the sources available.

endorsements.text: For the January 2026 special election, Ballotpedia lists endorsements or voter guide recommendations from Tabitha's List (Sway voting group by Tabitha Isner) and Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy (Sway voting group by Tevin (Momala) Davis). Ballotpedia found no endorsements for the November 2026 race.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Judith Taylor was born or raised, when she came to Alabama, or her occupation and work history. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, and we found no campaign website text, interviews or questionnaires stating her positions. We found no documented actions or statements on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or schools, and no news coverage of controversies or foreign ties.

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House for District 63, first elected in a January 2026 special election. Certified public accountant and former president of a local trucking company, DT Freight. Served on the Tuscaloosa City Schools Board of Education from 2013 to 2017. His campaign site also lists a Tuscaloosa City Council seat and real estate work.
cands.gaps: We could not find any stated positions or actions by Norman Crow on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, and the list of bills he has sponsored was empty on the page we read. We could not confirm his exact birthplace, where he grew up, or when he began living in Tuscaloosa. Sources disagree on his degree year (1990 on his campaign site, 1994 on Ballotpedia). Sources also differ on whether he served on the Tuscaloosa City Council, and we found no dates for that service. No notable endorsements were found.
